name: DCT-compressed time-runs rendering
aliases: Lum, Ma, and Clyne DCT method
definition: An algorithm by Lum, Ma, and Clyne that compresses time-runs of voxels using Discrete Cosine Transform (DCT) for interactive rendering.
summary: DCT-compressed time-runs rendering enables interactive volume rendering by compressing temporal voxel sequences into scalar indices, using hardware palette updates to decode time-varying data without inverse transforms.
